title: BEN Shareholder Skye Africa Intelligence Commissioned to Develop SafariOS Concierge in Tanzania
summary: BEN’s commercial-ready AI solutions deliver human-like responses using natural language, combined with the ability to remember customer details and problem solve in real-time on mobile devices, computers and stand-alone kiosks.
body_markdown:
**About Brand Engagement Network Inc.**


Brand Engagement Network, Inc. (“BEN”) builds secure, enterprise-grade artificial intelligence for the engagement layer of AI, where human intent is transformed into intelligent interactions, automated workflows, and real-world outcomes. Powered by BEN’s proprietary Engagement Language Model (ELM™), BEN’s technology enables conversational AI interactions that connect human intent to organizational data, workflows, and real-world outcomes. BEN’s AI operates within secure closed-loop environments using approved organizational data and built-in governance and compliance controls. For more information, visit www.brandengagementnetwork.com.


**About Skye Africa Intelligence**


Skye Africa Intelligence (Pty) Ltd applies conversational AI to hospitality, health, and public-sector services in Africa. The company is majority-held by Valio Technologies (Pty) Ltd, with Brand Engagement Network as a shareholder.


**Skye / Valio:** Lefentse Nokaneng | lefentsen@valiotechnologies.com
